title: Synthetic claim discovery instrument - diagnostic only
articles:
Article 1 — Context
This instrument describes the record-sharing programme for participating services. This description supplies context and imposes no independent duty.

Article 2 — Direct duty
A participating service must retain a receipt for each record transfer.

Article 3 — Mixed provision
Receipt retention supports programme transparency. A participating service must configure access to receipts for the record subject. This access duty does not apply to receipts subject to a valid confidentiality order. The access duty begins on 1 January 2031.

Article 4 — Referenced definition
The duty in Article 2 applies to each record transfer as defined in Article 6.

Article 5 — Temporal condition
For transfers initiated before 1 January 2031, receipt retention continues until 31 December 2031.

Article 6 — Definition
A record transfer means delivery of a record by a participating service to another participating service.
